body.name: positive heterogeneous categorical-table parameter space \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\)
body.construction: \(\Theta_{\Gamma,\Lambda}^{+}\) is the set of arrays of latent conditional-table entries on \(\mathcal Q\) and measurement conditional-table entries on \(\mathcal X_j\), for the fixed graphs \(\Lambda,\Gamma\), that obey all simplex constraints, the Markov factorization, and strict positivity of every table entry.
